products.name: DrumGirth
products.tagline: Kit generator, 16-pad sampler, kit brain, analog-style FX and 16 outs.
products.notes:
DrumGirth 0.3.1
- All 16 pads are drum hits by default (13 Perc 4, 14 Clap 2, 15 Open Hat 2, 16 Crash); LOOP CELL still on any pad
- PADS START AT: choose C1 / C2 / C3 / C4 (default C3 = pads C3 to D#4); stutter notes sit right above the pads
- Individual outputs: 16 extra stereo outs named "Pad 1 Kick" ... "Pad 16 Crash"; per-pad OUT: Main / Own / Both;
  one-click ALL PADS -> OWN OUTS
- Delay: SYNC toggle + Rate knob (1/64 to 1/1 incl. dotted + triplets) or free time 1 ms - 2 s

DrumGirth 0.3.0
- KIT BRAIN: kit source folder, genre picker (25 genres: trap to country/Americana), vibe box ("dark punchy dusty")
- Every hit is analysed for brightness, punch, low end, grit and length; genre + vibe rank the picks
- Per-pad SOURCE: drill into any folder/subfolder of your library, keywords filter, ANY TYPE toggle
- Sampler per pad: Start, Attack, Reverse, Gate mode, Pitch envelope
- Filter per pad: LP/HP 12+24 dB, Band, Notch, Resonance, Filter envelope; DJ filter, Crush, Drive
- Transient shaper (Punch / Sustain) per pad; Delay send per pad
- Master: tempo-synced ping-pong delay; STUTTER (1/4 to 1/64, tape stop, gate, reverse) - hold the buttons or play E2-B2
- CHARACTER: Reverb types Plate (classic 80s digital plate, modulated) / Hall (8-line lush hall) / Spring / Room
- CHARACTER: Ladder 24 (Moog-style, self-oscillates at max Reso) + MS-20 style dirty LP/HP filters per pad
- CHARACTER: Drive types per pad: Soft, Tube, Tape, Transformer, FET, Fuzz
- CHARACTER: Crush modes per pad: Digital, SP-12 (12-bit 26 kHz), MPC-60 (12-bit 40 kHz)
- CHARACTER: Compressor types Clean / Bus (glue) / FET (aggressive); Delay types Digital / Tape (wow + flutter)
- New skin: DRUMGIRTH logo, swirl background, 16 textured pads; resizable window that fits your screen

PHANTOMWAVS Hub 1.1.0
- Says AU + VST3, wordmark fixed, DrumGirth logo, self-update button

DrumGirth 0.2.0
- Renamed from Kit Maker to DrumGirth
- 16 pads in an MPC-style 4x4 grid (C1 to D#2)
- Loop cells: pads 13-16 are loops by default, any pad can be switched to a loop; locks to session tempo
- Per-hit FX: Pitch, Decay, Filter, Drive, Pan, Verb send, Sidechain Duck, Volume
- Sidechain: pick a source pad, every pad has its own Duck amount
- Master strip: 3-band EQ, compressor, GIRTH, reverb, clipper, output
- Psychedelic skin, animated logo, reverb ripple graphic
